race.title: Connolly's RED MILLS Irish EBF Auction & Median Maiden Hurdle
race.verdict: GIVE IT A CRACK has shaped with promise in this sphere and, with progress now expected, she’s fancied to open her account. Missouri Snow shaped promisingly on her hurdles debut and is feared most, while Conor’salwaysright is also respected. GIVE IT A CRACK MISSOURI SNOW (IRE) CONOR'SALWAYSRIGHT (IRE)
